editorial: Today's focus is on plugins that extend the capabilities of large language models and specialized architectures focused on cybersecurity. Current posts on GitHub show that tools that automate knowledge work processes and filtering systems that protect content quality are increasing.

items.title: Lum1104/Understand-Anything
items.summary: Understand-Anything offers a discoverable and queryable structure by turning code bases into interactive knowledge graphs. It provides visualization of software projects by integrating with various coding assistants and command line interfaces.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: ECC offers a performance framework that optimizes capability, memory, security and research-oriented development processes for artificial intelligence agents. Claude Code aims to standardize agent-based workflows by integrating with various coding tools such as Codex and Cursor.

items.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.summary: This resource, prepared for those who want to enter the field of artificial intelligence engineering (AI engineering), covers the application development and publishing processes, starting from the basics. It teaches how to build end-to-end artificial intelligence systems through Python-based projects with practical examples.

items.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
items.summary: Knowledge worker plugins published by Anthropics offer open source tools developed to increase productivity in the Claude Cowork environment. This Python-based library provides modular workflows that allow users to automate complex business processes.

items.title: mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
items.summary: Developed by Mukul975, Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills offers 754 structured capabilities (skills) for AI agents that are compatible with five different cybersecurity frameworks. This library covers 26 security domains, standardizing agent-based workflows across more than 20 platforms such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

items.title: hardikpandya/stop-slop
items.summary: Stop-slop is a tool that helps clean up characteristic narrative patterns and traces of AI (AI tells) in AI-generated texts. It optimizes language processing processes to make written content appear more natural and human-like.

items.title: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
items.summary: Taste-Skill is a tool developed to prevent the content produced by artificial intelligence models from becoming ordinary and generic slop. The system provides an originality-focused filtering layer to improve the output quality of language models.

items.title: DigitalPlatDev/FreeDomain
items.summary: DigitalPlat FreeDomain is an open source platform that allows users to obtain free domain names. The software aims to facilitate the process of creating digital identities for web projects in a cost-free manner.

items.title: jellyfin/jellyfin
items.summary: Jellyfin is an open source media server system that allows users to manage and publish their own media collections. Developed in C# language, this platform provides server-side management of media files and access via application programming interface (API).

items.title: Axorax/awesome-free-apps
items.summary: The awesome-free-apps list compiled by Axorax brings together free software options for PC and mobile devices. This resource offers an accessible guide by categorizing popular applications that users need.

items.title: twentyhq/twenty
items.summary: Twenty offers an open-source customer relationship management (CRM) platform focused on artificial intelligence (AI) integration. Developed with the TypeScript language, the project aims to create an alternative structure to traditional systems such as Salesforce.

items.title: Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock
items.summary: OpenStock offers real-time price tracking and personalized alerts as an open-source alternative to paid marketplace platforms. Developed with TypeScript, this tool provides detailed analysis of company data in a free and accessible manner.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.summary: Claude-mem is a tool that allows artificial intelligence agents to establish persistent context between sessions. It compresses the operations performed by the agent with artificial intelligence and transfers the relevant data to subsequent sessions and works compatible with different coding assistants.

items.title: st-tech/ppf-contact-solver
items.summary: ppf-contact-solver provides a solver that calculates contact interactions between shells, solids and rods in physics-based simulations. Developed with Python, this tool allows you to manage the interaction processes of complex physical objects in a standard way.

items.title: Spain blocks prediction markets Polymarket, Kalshi over lack of gambling licence
items.summary: Spain blocked access to prediction markets such as Polymarket and Kalshi on the grounds that they did not have a gambling license. These platforms are subject to supervision by local regulatory authorities due to their betting models based on the outcomes of events rather than financial instruments.

items.title: Dropbox CEO Drew Houston to step down
items.summary: Dropbox co-founder and chief executive officer Drew Houston is leaving his position. Ashraf Alkarmi, the current president of operations, takes over the leadership of the company in the new period.

items.title: A few interesting modern pixel fonts
items.summary: Modern pixel fonts are regaining popularity in digital interfaces by combining low-resolution screen aesthetics with current design needs. This font collection optimizes the limitations of traditional pixel art with modern typography techniques, improving readability on different screen scales.

items.title: That Methyl Methacrylate Tank
items.summary: Polymerization reactions occurring in methyl methacrylate tanks pose serious explosion risks as the inhibitors needed to maintain chemical stability are exhausted. The fact that the process gets out of control due to the effect of thermal runaway necessitates the meticulous application of industrial safety protocols.

items.title: The worst job interview I ever had
items.summary: In the software world, the inefficiency of job interview processes and faulty approaches towards candidates cause technical interview practices to be questioned again. Non-standard evaluation methods that negatively affect the candidate experience highlight the need for transparency in corporate recruitment processes.

items.title: bytedance-research/Lance
items.summary: Developed by ByteDance researchers, Lance offers an anything-to-any model architecture that transforms between different data types. This structure aims to create a flexible framework for processing multimodal data.

items.title: NemoStation/Marlin-2B
items.summary: Marlin-2B, developed by NemoStation, is a model that performs video-based text generation (video-text-to-text) operations. It is used in video processing processes with the ability to create text-based outputs by analyzing visual content.

items.title: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.5
items.summary: Developed by Meituan, LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.5 is a generative AI model that enables the creation of high-quality video avatars from text input. The system speeds up the process of modeling animated and realistic digital figures while maintaining the visual consistency of the characters.

items.title: openbmb/MiniCPM5-1B
items.summary: Developed by OpenBMB, MiniCPM5-1B is a low-parameter language model optimized for text generation tasks. With its compact structure, it offers efficient working capacity on end devices.

items.title: sapientinc/HRM-Text-1B
items.summary: Developed by Sapientinc, HRM-Text-1B is a language model optimized for text-generation tasks. Thanks to its low number of parameters, it offers a solution focused on resource efficiency.
